sectionTitles.dependence: Dependence and the eyes of Ibad

name: Spice
notes: SoA_Plant_SpiceBloom is leftover plant art/data; live melange comes from spice blows.

sections.body:
Spice connects an isolated sietch to the wider Imperium. A consignment can buy water, medicine or precision parts that local workshops cannot yet supply. Refining also produces measured melange doses for personal use.

The deposit lies where the desert puts it. Reaching it, working it and carrying the harvest home all compete with the colony’s need for shelter and water.
sections.title: The wealth beneath the sand

sections.body:
Spice blows create temporary fields on open sand. Each field holds 25–80 raw spice and lasts 180,000–480,000 game ticks, or three to eight days. Deposits can be exhausted before they dissipate.

After the map has no fields left, the drought interval for another blow is four to ten days, averaging about seven. A field is therefore an opportunity to plan around rather than a permanent farm.
sections.title: Spice blows and finite deposits

sections.body:
Workers can collect raw spice by hand or use a portable extractor after researching spice prospecting. On a deposit, the extractor takes 90 mining work for two spice and produces strong machine vibration. Sifting ordinary open sand is much slower: 2,400 work for one spice, at half the deposit-harvesting vibration.

Site the work with a retreat in mind. The machine can continue gathering while a colonist watches the desert, but its noise still raises the danger and its cargo still needs to be hauled away.
sections.title: Hand work and extraction

sections.body:
After Arrakis survival research, a drug-lab bill turns ten raw spice into four melange doses. A dose briefly heightens awareness and research insight. Raw spice can instead be kept for trade and delivery contracts.

These uses draw from the same harvest. Refining everything can leave a promising consignment short; selling everything can leave a dependent colonist without the next dose.
sections.title: Refining melange

sections.body:
A harvest party needs a stopping point before it starts work. Watch wormsign, keep the return route clear and allow time for the slowest worker to reach rock. Once a breach threatens the field, recovering every last unit can cost more than the remaining spice is worth.

Store enough everyday supplies that a poor blow or a lost extractor does not force another immediate trip onto dangerous sand.
sections.title: Choosing when to leave

sections.body:
Ten lifetime refined doses establish lasting melange dependence. Thirty stain natural eyes with the blue of Ibad. Exposure remains after the immediate awareness effect fades, and repeated doses still add exposure when awareness is already at its cap.

For an adult human, one dose restores half the chemical reserve, giving about four days of relief; body size can change the demand. When that reserve empties, withdrawal brings pain, fatigue and reduced consciousness and movement. Abstinence does not cure established dependence. The eye coloration marks exposure rather than granting prescience.
sections.title: Dependence and the eyes of Ibad

sections.body:
A powered communications terminal can arrange a caravan contract for 60 raw spice. New ordinary offers pay Solari at 1.25 times the cargo’s market value, rounded down: currently 900 Solari. One offer is available per ten days, with only one active contract at a time. Existing saved offers keep their rewards.

The receiver must be peaceful, available and within 32 tiles, with a journey that fits the delivery deadline. Slow terrain can make an apparently nearby settlement ineligible. Take food and drinking water for the trip.

Three completed ordinary deliveries and industrial spice processing unlock a final 300-spice consignment. Completing it earns a sietch charter and an optional ending, after which play can continue. The charter delivery pays no cash; failed deadlines and hostility can still end a contract.
sections.title: Spice deliveries and sietch recognition

sections.body:
Institutional contacts exchange spice for specific cargo through the powered terminal. At neutral goodwill, House factors offer 30 water and 120 steel for 40 raw spice. CHOAM offers 12 components and 40 plasteel for 100 spice at +20 goodwill. At +35, Guild freight brokered through CHOAM exchanges 200 spice for four advanced components and 40 hyperweave.

Peaceful Imperial relations at +50 unlock one lasgun focusing assembly for 200 spice. These consignments share the ten-day cooldown and single-active-contract limit with ordinary deliveries, but do not advance the sietch charter. A successful handover grants a base 12 goodwill, subject to the usual relationship modifiers and caps.
sections.title: House, CHOAM and Imperial procurement

code.purpose: Spice extractor deposit scrape and open-sand sift

summary: Melange rises from the sand in finite spice blows. It brings wealth, offworld supplies and influence, but harvesting it exposes people and machines to the Maker.
